messages:
samir: FYI: all-hands next Tue 11:00am PT. Theme: Sprint launch retro + product update. Plan: 7m exec overview, 12m launch metrics + incidents, 10m product roadmap, 8m reliability & mitigations, 5m demos (2 short), 8m curated Q&A. Please add must-cover items by EOD Monday.

elaine: Calendar invite up: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/2760012345>. Please RSVP.

mike_prod: For roadmap: will highlight the new routing policy and rollout timeline. Requesting 2 slides: "what changed" and "impact on customers".

anya_eng: Can we include a 60s clip of the new dashboard in the product section? I'll drop a short video in the drive if granted recording access.

kyle_sre: Ops note: we'll present the incident summary from last week's deploy slowdown. Short RCA + mitigation steps. Will post the one-pager here by Mon noon.

samir: Accessibility reminder: captions ON; transcript will be attached. If you need interpretation/ASL reply: "interpretation: yes".

anya_eng: LIVE question: will the rollout affect dedicated customers' SLAs?

mike_prod: LIVE answer: no SLA change expected; we'll route heavy traffic to dedicated pools during gradual rollout. We'll add details on the impact slide.

allhands-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h and 1h before. Recording will be posted to #all-hands-resources with transcript. :white_check_mark:

samir: Action items: 1) Presenters upload slides by Mon 5pm (owners: product, eng, SRE). 2) Kyle post incident one-pager Mon noon. 3) Anya submit demo clip by Mon EOD and request recording access if needed. 4) Everyone: drop Qs in-thread or use the intake form <https://forms.redwood.com/allhands-qa>. I'll publish final agenda Monday morning. Thanks all! :sparkles:
